params.name: codecIDs
params.description: IDs of all formats/codecs embedded in the picture, returned as file extensions (e.g. ".gif"), MIME types (e.g. "image/jpeg"), or 4-character QuickTime codes.

constraints: The JPEG, PNG, TIFF, GIF, BMP, SVG, PDF, and EMF codecs (handled internally by 4D) are always returned as extensions; 4-character QuickTime codes may appear only when the deprecated QuickTime support compatibility option is enabled.
